definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; to comminute; used only as denominative from 7447 ,

occurrences.englishText: You shall prepare a meal offering with it morning by morning, the sixth part of an ephah,§ 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel and the third part of a hin of oil, to moisten the fine flour; a meal offering to Yahweh continually by a perpetual ordinance.
